source_refs.note: Topic 7.3.3 with the Did You Know and class activity (PDF 184-185, printed 181-182). Long question 2 is answered; the activity answer is illustrative, flagged.

items: Government initiatives: build internet infrastructure where it is missing; in Pakistan the Universal Service Fund (USF) takes internet services to villages and remote areas.
Educational programmes: schools and community centres teach people to use computers and the internet for study and daily tasks.
Public-private partnerships: government working with businesses and non-profits can make technology more affordable.

blocks.text: The Government of Pakistan has launched initiatives such as mobile broadband in remote regions, but many areas still lack reliable connectivity (Did You Know).
